reference: Metadata contracts use Bash's documented type/help builtins and the netstat synopsis and help text documented by this loadable. No GNU netstat output is used as an oracle: operation-level netstat reads kernel socket state, which is outside this task's execution scope.
coverage: Executed coverage is Bash availability/help metadata only; no operational behavior is counted as a pass.
Bash builtin discoverability and documented synopsis/description metadata
exclusions: No netstat operation was invoked; the backend reads live sock_diag and /proc socket state, forbidden by the task's execution limits.
No real or fixture-created network sockets, syscall shims, or proc overlays were executed; deterministic operation coverage requires a future disposable VM/mock run.
No matching GNU netstat parity case is claimed.

cases.purpose: Check that the candidate exposes netstat as a Bash builtin, using Bash's documented type -t result.
Check the public option synopsis through Bash help metadata; the expected synopsis is the documented netstat short usage.
Check the concise help description against the first sentence in the loadable's published builtin documentation.
cases.stdout: netstat - netstat(8) surface (legacy column headers) over bashss.
